calls.title: GrowthBook & PodMe Catchup
calls.summary: During the call, Rami Daghlawi (PodMe engineer) raised concerns about GrowthBook’s SDK regarding data privacy (hashing of user IDs), network/performance impact, vendor lock-in, and EU data residency. James Shannon (GrowthBook sales) addressed these by explaining the SDK’s local caching, open-source/open-feature interoperability, and self-hosting option. Next steps: PodMe opted for cloud deployment with a requested
